turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Eh, still a bit groggy, but okay lah. Got some pain here, you know?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Can you rate the pain for me? On a scale of 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe 4 or 5? Mostly around the tummy area, like where they made the cuts.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any nausea or feeling like you might vomit? Sometimes the anesthesia can cause that.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A bit, yes. Not too bad, but my stomach feels funny. Like I want to throw up but can't.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Okay, we can give you something for that. How's your breathing? Any tightness or coughing?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing is okay, but my throat sore lah. Like someone put a tube there.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That’s normal after intubation. Do you remember anything from the operation itself?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, nothing. One minute I was talking, next thing I know, I’m waking up here.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Now, since you have high blood pressure and diabetes, any headaches, dizziness, or thirst?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Thirsty, yes. But no spinning or headache. Blood sugar was okay before surgery, right?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: We’ll check your blood sugar and blood pressure now. Rest is looking good, but let us know if anything worries you.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Okay, thanks. Just want to go home soon and eat proper food.
